# DLMtool

The Data-Limited Methods toolkit (`DLMtool`) is a library of over 100
data-limited management procedures (MPs) for use in fisheries management
strategy evaluation (MSE). It is part of the
[openMSE](https://openMSE.com) collection of R packages.

## openMSE 2.0

`DLMtool` 7.0 is part of the `openMSE` 2.0 release, alongside `MSEtool`
4.0. `MSEtool` 4.0 introduces a modular operating model structure, with
stock, fleet, observation, and implementation components defined as
independent objects, and a closed-loop MSE workflow based on `om`,
`hist`, and `mse` objects, replacing the earlier `OM`, `Hist`, and `MSE`
classes. The [technical documentation](https://docs.openMSE.com) covers
this workflow with worked examples.

`DLMtool`’s management procedures (MPs) predate this new structure and
are written against the legacy `Data` and `Rec` classes. They remain
fully supported:
[`MSEtool::Convert()`](https://msetool.openmse.com/reference/Convert.html)
automatically converts between the new `data` class and the legacy
`Data` class, so existing MPs run unchanged in either engine. See
[NEWS](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/news/) for details of what changed in
this release.

## Key Features

- **Large MP library**: output control (TAC), input control (effort,
  size limits, spatial closures), and mixed-control MPs, ranging from
  simple catch-based rules to model-based estimators
- **Works with `MSEtool` v4.0+**: legacy MPs run directly against
  `data`-class objects produced by `MSEtool`’s current `om`/`data`
  simulation engine, via automatic object conversion
  ([`MSEtool::Convert()`](https://msetool.openmse.com/reference/Convert.html))
- **Works with the legacy engine**: MPs remain fully compatible with the
  original `OM`/`Data` classes for existing workflows
- **Plain R functions**: every MP is a function that accepts a `Data`
  object and returns a `Rec` (recommendation) object, so new MPs are
  easy to write and test
- **Diagnostic tools**: functions for checking MP behaviour and data
  requirements before running a full MSE

Not every legacy MP maps cleanly onto the new engine: a small number
rely on legacy-only `Data` slots (e.g., `Data@Abun`, `Data@FMSY_M`,
`Data@BMSY_B0`) that `MSEtool`’s new observation model does not yet
populate when converting `data` to `Data`. These MPs fail with an
informative error rather than silently returning an invalid
recommendation; see `?Required` for each MP’s data requirements.

## Installation

You can install the released version of DLMtool from
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

``` r

install.packages("DLMtool")
```

And the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Blue-Matter/DLMtool")
```

## Documentation

- **[openMSE.com](https://openMSE.com)**: general information about the
  openMSE framework
- **[docs.openMSE.com](https://docs.openMSE.com)**: technical manual
  with worked examples covering operating model construction,
  simulation, and MSE analysis
- **[dlmtool.openmse.com](https://dlmtool.openmse.com)**: full function
  reference for `DLMtool`
- **[msetool.openmse.com](https://msetool.openmse.com)**: function
  reference for `MSEtool`, the core package providing the new
  `om`/`data` simulation engine

# Package index

## Output Controls

Management Procedures that return a total allowable catch (TAC)

- [`AvC()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/AvC.md) : Average
  Catch
- [`BK()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/BK.md)
  [`BK_CC()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/BK.md)
  [`BK_ML()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/BK.md) : Beddington
  and Kirkwood life-history MP
- [`CC1()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/CC1.md)
  [`CC2()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/CC1.md)
  [`CC3()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/CC1.md)
  [`CC4()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/CC1.md)
  [`CC5()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/CC1.md)
  [`CurC()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/CC1.md) : Geromont
  and Butterworth (2015) Constant Catch
- [`CompSRA()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/CompSRA.md)
  [`CompSRA4010()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/CompSRA.md) :
  Age-Composition Stock-Reduction Analysis
- [`DCACs()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DCAC.md)
  [`DCAC()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DCAC.md)
  [`DCAC_40()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DCAC.md)
  [`DCAC4010()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DCAC.md)
  [`DCAC_ML()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DCAC.md)
  [`DAAC()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DCAC.md)
  [`HDAAC()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DCAC.md) : Depletion
  Corrected Average Catch
- [`DBSRA()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DBSRA.md)
  [`DBSRA_40()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DBSRA.md)
  [`DBSRA4010()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DBSRA.md) :
  Depletion-Based Stock Reduction Analysis
- [`DD()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DD.md)
  [`DD4010()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DD.md) : Delay -
  Difference Stock Assessment
- [`Fratio()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/Fratio.md)
  [`Fratio4010()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/Fratio.md)

- [`DynF()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DynF.md) : Dynamic
  Fratio MP
- [`Fadapt()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/Fadapt.md) :
  Adaptive Fratio
- [`Fdem()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/Fdem.md)
  [`Fdem_CC()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/Fdem.md)
  [`Fdem_ML()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/Fdem.md) :
  Demographic FMSY method

## Input Controls

Management Procedures that return a total allowable effort (TAE),
spatial closure, or size regulation

- [`curE()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/curE.md)
  [`curE75()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/curE.md) : Fishing
  at current effort levels
- [`DDe()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DDe.md)
  [`DDes()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DDe.md)
  [`DDe75()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DDe.md) :
  Effort-based Delay - Difference Stock Assessment
- [`DTe40()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DTe40.md)
  [`DTe50()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/DTe40.md) : Effort
  searching MP aiming for a fixed stock depletion
- [`EtargetLopt()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/EtargetLopt.md)
  : Effort Target Optimum Length
- [`ItargetE1()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/ItargetE1.md)
  [`ItargetE2()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/ItargetE1.md)
  [`ItargetE3()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/ItargetE1.md)
  [`ItargetE4()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/ItargetE1.md) :

- [`ITe5()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/ITe5.md)
  [`ITe10()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/ITe5.md) : Index
  Target Effort-Based
- [`LstepCE1()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/LstepCE1.md)
  [`LstepCE2()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/LstepCE1.md) :
  Step-wise Constant Effort
- [`LtargetE1()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/LtargetE1.md)
  [`LtargetE4()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/LtargetE1.md) :

## Mixed Controls

Management Procedures that return a combination of Output and Input
controls

- [`AvC_MLL()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/AvC_MLL.md) :
  Average Catch with a size limit
- [`Itarget1_MPA()`](https://dlmtool.openmse.com/reference/Itarget1_MPA.md)
  : Itarget1 with an MPA
